title: Ugly and small. Nice as cat bowls
text: Ugly and small. Nice as cat bowls. I just can't get past how ugly these bowls are. Ugly doesn't inhibit functionality, but it does mean I only have limited uses for them. They are also small - they certainly aren't big enough for a bowl of cereal or soup for an adult. However, these do make fine cat bowls for for dry food and water. They are easy to clean and seem close to indestructible.
